02-doesnt-exist.name: Doesn't Exist
02-doesnt-exist.description: Doesn't Exist is a hardcover London magazine that looks at fashion through cinema. Each issue is built around a filmmaker or film movement, most recently an unofficial tribute to Federico Fellini, and fills it with fashion editorials, illustration, interviews and essays that answer those films. It is for readers who collect fashion photography and arthouse film culture in equal measure.
02-doesnt-exist.note: Loaded as dormant: the latest issue (March 2025) is over the validator's 18 month liveness limit for an active title, although it meets the January 2025 cut off. Publisher states an April and October schedule but Issue Seven (March 2025) is still the latest in November 2026, so frequency is irregular. Issue Seven is sold as a GBP 39 two volume set.

03-dossier.name: Dossier
03-dossier.description: Dossier is a New York print magazine about travel, culture and style, relaunched in 2024 after an earlier life as a fashion and art title. Each biannual issue is organised around places, from the Mekong countries to Madagascar and Palm Springs, and mixes long travel features, fashion stories shot on location, photography, short fiction and conversations with chefs, musicians and writers. It is for readers who want slow, luxury leaning travel journalism with a literary bent.
03-dossier.note: Issue Five (Fall Winter 2026) was on pre-order on 17 November 2026, so Issue Four is recorded.

09-the-light-observer.name: The Light Observer
09-the-light-observer.description: The Light Observer is a compact English language magazine about light itself. Each issue takes one idea, such as night, play or landscape, and gathers photographic series, artists' projects and essays alongside conversations with artists, filmmakers, architects and scientists about how they understand and use light. It suits readers of photography and contemporary art who like slow, essayistic magazines built around a single concept.
09-the-light-observer.note: Publisher has a head office in Vinzelles and a studio in Nice; Nice is recorded. Price EUR 17.06 in the publisher shop while the cover prints EUR 18. Frequency annual from cadence.

10-the-lissome.name: The Lissome
10-the-lissome.description: The Lissome is a Berlin print journal at the meeting point of slow fashion, ecology and craft, with each edition organised around one inquiry and filled with long essays, interviews, photography and artists' contributions on subjects such as wool and sheep breeds, wild tea and textile folklore. Editions run to around 144 pages and appear with two covers. It is for readers interested in sustainable fashion, regenerative design and nature centred culture rather than seasonal trends.
10-the-lissome.note: Published by The Lissome Verein, a registered Berlin association. Frequency annual from cadence (gaps closer to sixteen months).

11-the-new-order.name: THE NEW ORDER
11-the-new-order.description: THE NEW ORDER is a large format Tokyo magazine on global street culture, covering fashion, music, art, skateboarding and design through long interviews and photographic editorials shot in Tokyo, Los Angeles, Paris and beyond. Each themed issue appears with several split covers, some made with partner brands and sold through their stores. It suits readers of fashion and subculture titles who want slower, in depth reportage.
11-the-new-order.note: Store prices in USD. The Issue 39 description calls it the last edition representing the publication's progressive vision, which may or may not mean the title is ending; please check before approving.
